score_scale.0: Not credible, not specified, or mostly vibes.
score_scale.1: Interesting but underspecified; likely to fake success.
score_scale.2: Buildable with clear blockers and receipts.
score_scale.3: Strong enough to ship into the next build packet.

does_not_claim: Real-time shared Aeye cognition is solved

dimensions.label: Central claim
dimensions.attack_question: Is human as missing message bus true enough to carry Chapter One?
dimensions.required_evidence: Quote the strongest sentence and the weakest overreach.

dimensions.label: Cooperation model
dimensions.attack_question: Does shared body-state, not shared mind, solve the actual Aeye cooperation problem?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name the first place packeted cooperation still fails.

dimensions.label: Custody spine
dimensions.attack_question: Does the custody spine cover the real workflow?
dimensions.required_evidence: Identify one missing transition or unnecessary organ.

dimensions.label: Contract canon
dimensions.attack_question: Are packet, receipt, event, gate, and boot-context contracts the right first build?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name one required field that is missing or one field that is decorative.

dimensions.label: Gate model
dimensions.attack_question: Is classifier decides, policy narrows, OS enforces, receipts prove enough?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name where enforcement is still prose instead of OS/API boundary.

dimensions.label: Receiver proof
dimensions.attack_question: Does the architecture prevent sender-side custody from masquerading as receiver completion?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name one path where ACK, custody, and completion can still blur.

dimensions.label: Boot context
dimensions.attack_question: Does stale world-state reliably block Aeye action?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name one Aeye surface that can still bypass boot context.

dimensions.label: Event spine
dimensions.attack_question: Can packet, event, receipt, artifact, and next action join by id?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name the join that would fail first under stress.

dimensions.label: Cockpit readback
dimensions.attack_question: Can Ben return after four hours and see state without reconstructing the thread?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name the one screen or field still missing.

dimensions.label: Secret and human gates
dimensions.attack_question: Do secrets, provider dashboards, deploy, money, and legal gates stay human-owned?
dimensions.required_evidence: Name one gate that must never be automated silently.

dimensions.label: Minimal MVP
dimensions.attack_question: What is the smallest build that proves momentum?
dimensions.required_evidence: Choose one: contract canon, event join, boot enforcement, receiver proof, cockpit readback.

dimensions.label: Manuscript balance
dimensions.attack_question: Does the prose preserve myth without overclaiming the machinery?
dimensions.required_evidence: Mark one sentence to keep and one sentence to cut or quarantine in appendix.

fatal_flags: Claims real-time shared Aeye consciousness without a falsifiable mechanism.
Treats a prompt, watcher, or classifier as containment.
Treats sender-side packet write as delivery proof.
Treats transport ACK as receiver work completion.
Routes secrets through chat, logs, or source files.
Lets stale world-state become current truth.
Requires Ben to keep being the clipboard or message bus after claiming otherwise.
Cannot produce a next legal command from the cockpit.

conversion_rule.ACCEPT: Next build packet may preserve the current sequence and choose the first momentum build.
conversion_rule.REVISE: Next build packet must include must_change_before_book items as acceptance criteria.
conversion_rule.REJECT: No next-build packet should be generated until Ben explicitly accepts a replacement architecture direction.
